Maya (CSM): Quick sync — NovaCorp Dedicated bring-up is scheduled for Wed. Need final quota table, autoscale policy, and loadtest windows. Renewal at EOM so first-week health is high priority.
Anika (Solutions Eng): I can run shadow loads + soak. What are target steady/peak numbers?
Ravi (SRE): For their reserved pool let's plan steady ~250 qps, peak bursts up to ~600. Recommend three runs: smoke (10m), ramp (30m), soak (60m). Autoscale suggestion below.
Sam (Product): Product asks for a fallback flag to smaller model if latency exceeds 800ms. Also want a short feedback survey + 1:1 follow-up after go-live.
Maya (CSM): Adding to checklist. @Ravi can you paste the autoscale policy snippet here? Also need KV/prefix cache priming steps.
Ravi (SRE): Sure — autoscale snippet:

```
autoscale:
  min: 2
  max: 12
  metric: p95_latency_ms
  target: 450
  window_sec: 60
  cooldown_sec: 120
```

Ravi (SRE): For cache priming: run the seed script with the canonical prompt set T-24h.
Anika (Solutions Eng): Loadrunner command for tests:

```
./loadrunner --target https://staging.api.redwood/nova --rps 250 --duration 30m --pattern ramp --out metrics.json
```

Anika (Solutions Eng): I'll schedule smoke Tue 03:00-03:20 UTC, ramp Tue 03:30-04:00 UTC, soak Wed 00:00-01:00 UTC. Is that ops-safe?
Maya (CSM): Ops window looks ok. We'll need Support on-call for the runs. Also capture CSAT + a short incident survey at T+48h.
Jules (Support): I'm covering Tue/Wed. I'll monitor error rates, throttle alerts, and capture initial CSAT responses. I'll prepare a support playbook link.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled for 2024-06-05T22:00Z — ticket #INC-4521 :white_check_mark:
Anika (Solutions Eng): I'll do a light priming run 24h prior to ramp to warm KV cache and common prefixes.
Maya (CSM): Noted. I'll also send the renewal owner a heads-up and attach the enablement deck + pre-mortem template. There's a moderate renewal risk flagged from POC latency — we'll keep high-touch for 2w post-go-live.
Ravi (SRE): I'll add runbook entries to the repo (ops/runbooks/nova-onboard.md), enable fallback route to open-models if p99 errors spike, and turn on token-level cost dashboards for the account.
Maya (CSM): Final action items:
1) Ravi: commit autoscale policy + runbook link.
2) Anika: create and share loadtest schedule + raw scripts.
3) Jules: publish support playbook + CSAT link.
4) Maya: email kickoff + renewal note to account owner.
Ping in this thread when each item is done. :thumbsup:
